entities.name: UAC-0063
entities.gloss: A cyber espionage threat group active since at least 2021 targeting organizations across multiple countries.

entities.name: SvcRestartTaskLogon
entities.gloss: A malicious DOCX file containing macros used to advance the infection chain.

entities.name: WsSwapAssessmentTask
entities.gloss: A macro-enabled malicious file used to create and schedule the execution of HATVIBE.

entities.name: SoftwareProtectionPlatform
entities.gloss: A malicious script file representing an instance of the HATVIBE malware.

entities.name: HATVIBE
entities.gloss: An encoded VBScript downloader malware used to download and execute additional payloads.

entities.name: LOGPIE
entities.gloss: A Python-based keylogger designed to capture keystrokes and clipboard data.

entities.name: CHERRYSPY
entities.gloss: A Python-based backdoor malware capable of executing Python code received from a command-and-control server.

entities.name: STILLARCH
entities.gloss: A malware strain also known as DOWNEX used to locate and exfiltrate files.

entities.name: PyArmor
entities.gloss: A command-line tool used to obfuscate and protect Python scripts.

entities.name: Themida
entities.gloss: A software protection system designed to prevent reverse engineering and software cracking.

entities.name: slmgr.vbe
entities.gloss: A malicious VBE script file associated with the attack chain.

entities.name: WinTime.py
entities.gloss: A Python script file implementing the LOGPIE keylogger functionality.

entities.name: pytransform.pyd
entities.gloss: A compiled Python extension module used by PyArmor for code protection.

entities.name: help.py
entities.gloss: A Python script file implementing the CHERRYSPY backdoor.

entities.name: Diagsvc.exe
entities.gloss: An executable file associated with the STILLARCH malware family.
